subject.title: [AI] fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should the Matrix 20-option protocol limit also become the default contract for every `normalizePollInput` plugin-SDK caller?
rationale: The upstream contract supports 20 for Matrix, but current architecture carries limits at transport boundaries and does not establish that value as universal OpenClaw SDK policy.

options.title: Cap Matrix explicitly
options.body: Pass `maxOptions: 20` from Matrix and leave the generic SDK helper uncapped unless another owner supplies a native limit.

options.title: Define a universal ceiling
options.body: Keep the shared default but document and test 20 as the intentional cross-plugin OpenClaw contract before shipping the new SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Cap Matrix explicitly
recommendation.body: Pass `maxOptions: 20` from Matrix and leave the generic SDK helper uncapped unless another owner supplies a native limit.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared poll API and plugin-SDK export whose permanent contract needs confirmation.
